candidates.label: Haploinsufficiency (one working copy is not enough)
candidates.summary: One of the two gene copies is lost or inactive, so the cell makes too little of a protein it needs. The remaining copy cannot cover the shortfall.

candidates.label: Protein serine/threonine kinase activity
candidates.summary: Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

candidates.label: Protein destabilization / misfolding
candidates.summary: The variant protein is made but is unstable or misfolds, so it is degraded, aggregates, or is retained inside the cell instead of reaching its working location.

candidates.label: GALC-related disorders (Krabbe disease)

candidates.label: ARSA-related disorders (metachromatic leukodystrophy)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of arylsulfatase A makes sulfatides build up and destroys myelin in the brain and nerves, causing loss of motor and cognitive skills.
